name: pr-flow
description: A skill that writes PR descriptions a reviewer can act on, a CI script whose one backgroundable call takes a branch from a CI verdict through the merge to the deploy that ships it — GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build — printing only the failing log, a PreToolUse hook that denies that wait in the foreground so it never freezes the session, and a PostToolUse hook that carries every commit through to a pushed branch, an open PR, a green CI and a change that is actually live by saying what the branch still owes, right after each commit and push.
